Omar (Marketing): We need a fresh battlecard angle for the upcoming webinar: emphasize routing & graceful degradation vs big cloud vendors. Field request: one-page AE summary + quick SDR lines + routing pseudo-code.
Eve (Product): Key datapoints to include: p95 under 1000 concurrent sessions, cost per 1M tokens vs CloudAPI_X, and example fallback chain (hosted -> dedicated -> lite-quantized). I'll provide numbers.
Ravi (Sales): SDR script (2 lines):
1) \"Curious how your inference bill scales with users?\"
2) \"We focus on serving, not just models 10\"
I'll craft enterprise variants.
Lily (Growth): HubSpot routing prototype:
```
if (form.role == 'engineering' && est_tokens > 1e8) route = 'ae-engineering-demo';
else if (company.employees > 500 && est_tokens > 5e8) route = 'enterprise-sales';
else route = 'marketing-nurture';
```
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled. Logs: https://ci.redwood/deploy/600 (ok).
Omar (Marketing): Owners: Eve -> microbench + battlecard content; Ravi -> SDR + procurement bullets; Lily -> HubSpot routing + CTA tests. Drafts by Tue.
Eve (Product): I'll include a short blurb: \"Serving complexity is orthogonal to model quality; Redwood optimizes the serving plane.\"
Ravi (Sales): Adding rebuttals vs self-host: ops overhead, kernel optimization, and dev time.
Lily (Growth): We'll add a hidden est_tokens field in the form. A/B: CTA \"Request demo\" vs \"Talk to sales\".
Omar (Marketing): Thanks. I'll synthesize and share a draft page.
